title: 澳泊 / ParkGo — One movement
concept: 一個持續前進的藍色路線點，將巴士、預計到站與停車資訊串連成簡潔一致的智慧出行敘事。
visual_motif: Single blue waypoint dot persists and changes jobs across the film

audio.music: BGM 尚未提供；需要授權音樂

scenes.purpose: Hook — one quiet line that becomes a route
scenes.why_this_scene: Creates immediate curiosity with one identifiable object rather than an anonymous brand card.
scenes.subject: Blue moving waypoint dot

frame.composition: Large negative space; thin route line enters from lower-left
frame.safe_area: Avoid platform controls near top and bottom in vertical format

scenes.action: The dot draws a single path, then pauses at the first meaningful point.

motion.motivation: Establish a continuous path through the product
motion.signature_move: Line draw led by one dot

transition.seam_note: Dot becomes the map focus point in S02

continuity.exit: dot held at centre-right with a line behind it

keyframe_notes: 0.0s — empty spacious field with a tiny blue point
0.9s — line curves into a purposeful transit route
1.8s — dot lands at future map focus

scenes.why_this_scene: Introduces the first concrete user outcome using actual app imagery once supplied.
scenes.subject: Actual bus route UI screenshot region (required)

frame.composition: Real screen crop occupies middle 60%; feature heading outside screen
frame.focal_point: blue dot aligned with bus focus marker
frame.safe_area: Retain UI text in frame; adjust vertical crop

camera.movement: single axis push into route detail

scenes.action: Route map enters through the dot handoff; bus route details become clear.

motion.motivation: Move from abstract route into real product interface

transition.seam_note: Keep dot alignment to map waypoint; no UI redesign

continuity.entry: route point exactly matches S01 exit

keyframe_notes: 1.8s — real UI crop replaces conceptual field
3.0s — route focus settles on authentic map
4.2s — anchored highlight prepares the ETA handoff

scenes.purpose: Reveal arrival estimates without fake times
scenes.why_this_scene: Makes the bus feature personally useful by showing where timing information would appear.
scenes.subject: Actual ETA component captured from app (required)

frame.composition: Focused card / UI detail with generous surrounding negative space
frame.safe_area: No invented countdown digits in concept render

camera.movement: none after a short shared-element shift

scenes.action: Selected route detail leads visually to its ETA area; interface remains factual.

motion.motivation: Explain relationship between route and arrival

transition.exit_state: focus line contracts back to dot
transition.seam_note: Last highlight resolves to the same dot used throughout

continuity.exit: single blue dot ready to travel

keyframe_notes: 5.2s — crop lands on app ETA information
6.8s — highlight reduces to the persistent dot

scenes.why_this_scene: Demonstrates two product categories as one integrated mobility story, not an unrelated montage.
scenes.subject: Waypoint moving from bus map element to parking label

frame.composition: Spatial composition with a restrained single route stroke
frame.safe_area: Labels only; no invented availability number

scenes.action: Blue dot follows a line into a simple parking glyph, and real parking UI takes focus.

motion.motivation: Make feature transition causal and continuous

transition.seam_note: Dot remains same perceived diameter and follows same travel direction

keyframe_notes: 6.8s — ETA UI retreats behind continuing blue line
8.0s — line flows across empty canvas without particle effects

scenes.purpose: Real parking information as second payoff
scenes.why_this_scene: Proves the app's cross-category utility while preserving authentic, legible product UI.
scenes.subject: Actual parking availability interface screenshot (required)

frame.composition: Single authentic parking UI detail, headline upper-left
frame.focal_point: parking status region, but no fabricated counts
frame.safe_area: Check all car-type labels at target vertical crop

camera.movement: short contained UI pan only if source geometry permits

scenes.action: A parking row/card is revealed by clipped movement, then holds long enough to read.

motion.motivation: Reveal relevant data without decorative noise

transition.seam_note: Parking marker collapses into final brand motif

continuity.exit: one clean line leading to brand frame

keyframe_notes: 9.5s — parking card enters from the already visible marker
12.5s — line pulls forward into brand resolve

scenes.purpose: Resolve single route motif into ParkGo identity
scenes.why_this_scene: Creates a clear ending that unifies the shown features and identifies the app.
scenes.subject: Approved 澳泊 / ParkGo wordmark and app icon (asset required)

frame.composition: Quiet centered identity only at ending, not a generic intro card
frame.safe_area: Leave room for app-store endcard if later requested

scenes.action: The blue route point becomes the icon accent; approved wordmark is unveiled.

motion.easing: short decisive settle, then quiet hold

transition.seam_note: Must match supplied icon; do not redraw an imaginary brand

continuity.entry: route line from S05 narrows to a point

keyframe_notes: 12.5s — transit line lands as a small mark
13.2s — authentic logo appears via a one-time mask
15.0s — stable branded end frame, enough time to read
